messages.text:
Hawk: ...I could not
do it well at all.{be01}
Dar: ...I could not
do it right at all.

They can do even the hardest things
as if they were so simple...{be01}
That's the great thing
about professionals.

We cannot have
a one-on-two battle.

We were watching various team sports,
and we wanted to fight as a duo, too!{be01}

We would like to have
a Pokémon battle as a duo.
